sloka: गृहीत्वा क्षीरम् एक अह्ना सुकुमार वपुः तदा ।अजयत् स्वेन वीर्येण दैत्य सैन्य गणान् विभुः ॥१-३७-२९॥
transliteration: gṛhītvā kṣīram eka ahnā sukumāra vapuḥ tadā ।ajayat svena vīryeṇa daitya sainya gaṇān vibhuḥ ॥1-37-29॥

translations.english: Drinking milk just for a day and with a body still tender he could vanquish hosts of demons by his inborn prowess so capable be was
